scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exact strict complete balanced stable marriage, with zero-based rank and positive utility n-r. The n=2,3 lower-side classification follows a full finite exhaustive checker; universal n>=4 separation follows an explicit analytically padded witness. No claims about ties, incomplete preference lists, alternative utilities, or independence are made. The available literature search does not prove worldwide novelty.
title: A sharp small-market boundary between Nash-optimal and minimum-regret stable marriage
